conventions.coords: rect = [x, y, w, h] px in the source image; cells = [col, row] on the source grid; cells_index = linear index row-major
conventions.lut_order: luts apply left-to-right on SOURCE colours; L_SFX_BASE is always implied for simplefx unless a more specific LUT already mapped the colour
conventions.tint_tokens: see style-guide.md §2.4 — dev maps token names, never hexes
conventions.projectile_scale: visual scale = 1 if radius multiplier < 1.5, 2 if 1.5-2.49, 3 if >= 2.5 (size_up x1.6 -> x2). Hitbox follows data exactly; player visuals may exceed hitboxes, enemy bullets never do.
conventions.ebullet_rule: enemy projectile radius r -> ebullet.<element>.<2r+1> (frost 9/13 px have a rim broken at the 4 diagonals = segmented crystal ring, the grayscale cue for the slowing shot); radius 3/4/6 map exactly; any other radius -> nearest size UP (v2: radius 5 -> 11 px) so the visible disc covers the hitbox + 1 px. Death on wall/expiry: fx.ebullet_pop.

boss_telegraph.principle: Bosses have idle/run only. Every attack is told by FOUR stacked channels, none of them new body frames: (1) body tint ADD token telegraph-hot ramping to peak in the last 150 ms (Animator R5 priority 4); (2) a 1/8-step scale pulse (Animator R4) ; (3) a ground decal in the hostile telegraph colours showing WHERE; (4) a type glyph FX at the boss core showing WHAT.

per_attack_type.melee_swipe: decal: filled arc (arcDeg, range) telegraph-fill + 1px telegraph-rim; act: fx.enemy_slash scaled to range with integer steps (x1 <= 32 px range, x2 above); knight also raises boss_knight_blade overlay
per_attack_type.ring: decal: 1px telegraph-rim circle at 24 px pulsing; core glyph: fx.cast_glyph (hostile) ; bullets appear on the ring
per_attack_type.shoot: decal: 1 px telegraph-rim line per aimed bullet, 48 px long, locking 150 ms before release; core glyph: fx.cast_glyph (hostile)
per_attack_type.spiral: core glyph: fx.cast_glyph rotating + 1/8-step scale pulse 1.0/1.125 at 4 Hz
per_attack_type.charge: decal: lane rect (body width x charge length) telegraph-fill + rim, locked at windup start
per_attack_type.slam: decal: filled circle (radius) telegraph-fill + rim for windup+travel; landing = fx.explosion hostile variant
per_attack_type.summon: decal per spawn point: fx.summon_sigil (hostile protection circle) then fx.spawn_portal
per_attack_type.hazard: decal: circle (radius) telegraph-rim only during windup; active = hazard.<element>
per_attack_type.blink: fx.blink_puff at origin and destination; body alpha steps 1 -> 0.5 -> 0
per_attack_type.sequence: each step uses its own type
per_attack_type.self_destruct: (fire_imp) decal: filled circle at blast radius 36 telegraph-fill + rim from windup start; body: telegraph-hot + 1/8-step swell 1.0 -> 1.25 over the windup (Animator R4 transient) + FILL flash every 100 ms in the last 300 ms; act: fx.explosion hostile variant
per_attack_type.phase_change: invuln tint (R5 p5) + fx.phase_burst from core + camera flash owned by Animator/UX (reduced-motion safe)
per_attack_type.guard: shield raised: held shield overlay appears on the facing side + shield_arc bubble at alpha 0.8 for the guard duration; windup = shield lifts 2 px over 3 steps (Animator)
per_attack_type.ward_allies: caster core glyph fx.ward_kindle (8_protectioncircle tinted #72d6ce, 4 f) + a 1 px #72d6ce line to each target during windup; each target gains its ward runes on act
per_attack_type.mirror: fan preview lines (telegraph-rim) whose COUNT equals the shots the player fired in their last cast — the "reads your wand" beat must be countable
per_attack_type.heat_attack: heat attacks reuse their type grammar (hazard / ring / spiral); bone_rain adds authored bone_shard falling into each mark

overload.label: OVERLOAD

layers: authored glow_64 ADD tint element.light alpha 0.8 -> 0 (flash, 2 steps)
expl16 f0-4 (L_EXPL16) @ 20 fps at integer scale k = 2 if radius <= 32 else 3 (FX-only integer upscale, style-guide §3.3)
1 px Graphics ring at exactly `radius`, element.light (player) / telegraph-rim (enemy), 120 ms (Animator)

layers: ui_authored g_star_7 pops in at frame 8 (Animator)

formats.vertical_9x16: 360x640 re-compose (not crop): wordmark top third, hero centre, enemies stacked below the door; x3 export 1080x1920

shield.held_rule: overlay at the `hand` anchor on the facing side (flipX with the body); state by blocks taken: fresh < 1/3 wearBlocks <= worn < 2/3 <= cracked
shield.bubble_rule: 150 deg frontal arc, radius = body radius + 4 (nearest provided size up; x2 bosses use the x2-radius arc, never a scaled arc); faces +x, rotate to facing; shown at alpha 0.5 while the shield stands, the _hit frame for 2 steps on each block
shield.break: fx.freeze_shatter LUT-steel (#b6cbcf debris) + "BROKEN" word (UX) + held overlay removed

armour.bar: Graphics 16x3 above the head (x2 bosses: 32x3): 1 px #222222 keyline, fill #b6cbcf, 1 px #417089 notch every 25 % = the plates; drains with points
armour.hit_rule: direct hit on armour -> 1 chip + grey "ARMOURED" number; blast hit -> 3 chips + bar flash FILL #fdf7ed 1 step

ward.pip_rule: one 5x5 rune per max hit, centred row 3 px above the head, 1 px apart (max 6 -> 35 px); full = charge left, spent = used, regrow = regrowing (elite ward regrowMs)
ward.absorb_fx: fx.hit_ring tinted #72d6ce + the spent rune flips
ward.strip_fx: fx.chain_arc short burst tinted #fdf7ed across the pips on a shock hit
ward.distinct_from_player_shield: the player warding_sigil shield is the 8_protectioncircle ring; enemy wards are rune pips only — no ring

defences.dark_twist_outline: rules.twists.dark.enemyOutline: every enemy draws its ring1 frame tinted #fdf7ed (see affix_outline recipe); player light = authored light_r72, spells = light_r28 (erase brush on a #0d0a10 alpha 0.85 RenderTexture)

affix_outline_recipe: scripts/author-art.py outline_rings(): TA bakes ring1 + ring2 (white, Chebyshev distance 1 / 2 from the silhouette, frame padded 2 px, origin +2,+2) for every enemy sheet frame (all enemies: the dark twist outlines everyone). Runtime tints ring1 with the first affix token, ring2 with the second (Heat 2+). Replaces the v1 elite-gold bake: the elite read is now affix outline + glyph + title.

duo.ui: DUO chip (UX, procedural) + both parent icon16 with ✔ (g_ok) per owned parent
duo.world: pedestal glow = two glow_16 (one per parent element) offset 3 px

corrupted.ui: ui_authored g_corrupt_7 badge top-right on the icon cell (cracked plum seal; shape, not hue)
corrupted.world: pedestal glow_16 MULTIPLY #5f2d56 (a dim, not a glow) + slow 1 px jitter (Animator)
corrupted.rule: corrupted is a player-owned RISK, not an enemy: never the hostile pink band

goals.reward_icon_rule: the unlocked card/relic/wand/loadout icon; features use FEATURE_ICONS; later-goal rewards shown as the icon silhouette (fill #2a2a3a, keyline #778d9f) — no spoiler

twists.ambush: spawn portals (fx.spawn_portal) at portalMs 1100 in a ring; banner only
twists.dark: rules.twists.dark.enemyOutline: every enemy draws its ring1 frame tinted #fdf7ed (see affix_outline recipe); player light = authored light_r72, spells = light_r28 (erase brush on a #0d0a10 alpha 0.85 RenderTexture)
twists.candlelight: candlelight twist: authored light_r28 per candle at ambient 0.55 (the dark-twist renderer); torches everywhere else, torch-light #ee8e2e
twists.flooded: flooded twist `water` tile: shallow, walkable, slows; lighter + shimmering so it never reads as a pit; shock arcs in water = fx.chain_arc tinted #72d6ce
twists.bookshelves: bookshelves twist tile (pillar variant): 16x32, feet on the cell, 16 px overhang, y-sorted like column; burning = flame frames + glow_16 #ee8e2e; collapses to floor debris

w1_sunken_crypt.light: candlelight twist: authored light_r28 per candle at ambient 0.55 (the dark-twist renderer); torches everywhere else, torch-light #ee8e2e
w1_sunken_crypt.placement: candles on floor cells adjacent to walls/pillars (3-6 per room, data); bone piles 1-3 per room; cobwebs in NW/NE inner corners only

w2_drowned_halls.floor: TILES.floor through L_FLOOR_F2 + moss_a/moss_b overlays on 12 % of floor cells (never within 1 tile of a door or spawn)

pits.rule: deep water = impassable; darker than shallow water

water.edge: water_edge_n rotated 90/180/270 where a water cell borders floor
water.rule: flooded twist `water` tile: shallow, walkable, slows; lighter + shimmering so it never reads as a pit

drain.note: north-wall decor, animated drip (Puny rows 2-3 are the 2-tile tall drain)

w2_drowned_halls.light: cold: torches swapped for blue fountains + glow_32 ADD #72d6ce alpha 0.25 at each drain/fountain; no warm light except lantern_acolyte/matron

floor.rule: dark parquet replaces the 0x72 stone floor (floor band L 0.029-0.04)

w3_last_library.walls: L_FLOOR_F3 + wall_shelf over every north-face wall tile except door frames and torch cells

bookshelf.rule: bookshelves twist tile (pillar variant): 16x32, feet on the cell, 16 px overhang, y-sorted like column; burning = flame frames + glow_16 #ee8e2e; collapses to floor debris

w3_last_library.light: candlelit + arcane: candelabra glow_16 #facb3e alpha 0.35; rune circles glow_32 ADD #5956bd alpha 0.2 (static, never pulsing — only telegraphs pulse)

w2_drowned_halls.backdrop: slate wall strip + drain + shallow water row

world_cards.rule: world-entry card = a 640x96 band: the world backdrop strip at 1x, emblem at 1x, name T2 + fantasy line T1 (outlined glyphs); accent = the world light colour. No sprite upscaling.
